import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_function struct
class GSLFunction(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('function', ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double)),
                ('params', ctypes.c_void_p)]

# Define the function to integrate
@ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double)
def my_function(x):
    return np.sin(x)

# Define the integration function
def integrate_function(func, a, b):
    # Create a GSL function
    gsl_func = GSLFunction(func, None)

    # Prepare result variables
    result = ctypes.c_double()
    abserr = ctypes.c_double()
    resabs = ctypes.c_double()
    resasc = ctypes.c_double()

    # Call the gsl_integration_qk61 function
    gsl.gsl_integration_qk61(ctypes.byref(gsl_func), ctypes.c_double(a), ctypes.c_double(b),
                             ctypes.byref(result), ctypes.byref(abserr),
                             ctypes.byref(resabs), ctypes.byref(resasc))

    return result.value, abserr.value, resabs.value, resasc.value

# Test cases

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Integrate sin(x) from 0 to pi
    result, abserr, resabs, resasc = integrate_function(my_function, 0, np.pi)
    assert np.isclose(result, 2.0, atol=1e-5), f"Expected 2.0, got {result}"
    assert abserr < 1e-5, f"Expected error < 1e-5, got {abserr}"

    # Test case 2: Integrate sin(x) from 0 to 2*pi
    result, abserr, resabs, resasc = integrate_function(my_function, 0, 2*np.pi)
    assert np.isclose(result, 0.0, atol=1e-5), f"Expected 0.0, got {result}"
    assert abserr < 1e-5, f"Expected error < 1e-5, got {abserr}"

    # Test case 3: Integrate sin(x) from -pi to pi
    result, abserr, resabs, resasc = integrate_function(my_function, -np.pi, np.pi)
    assert np.isclose(result, 0.0, atol=1e-5), f"Expected 0.0, got {result}"
    assert abserr < 1e-5, f"Expected error < 1e-5, got {abserr}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
